source.name: Open English WordNet
source.changes: Definitions selected by sense and adapted into two original clue phrasings.

aback.stronger: An adverb in an expression meaning startled by an unexpected remark.

abbe.stronger: The French title for the senior monk who governs a monastic community.

acacia.gentle: A kind of tree or shrub.
acacia.stronger: A woody member of the group that includes many wattles and thorn trees.

acclivity.stronger: An upward gradient like a stretch of road that climbs a hill.

acyl.gentle: A group found in organic chemistry.
acyl.stronger: An oxygen-bearing group left when a carboxylic acid loses the hydroxyl part of its carboxyl group.

aery.gentle: The high nest of a bird of prey.
aery.stronger: A hawk's or eagle's nest built in a lofty place such as a cliff ledge.

again.stronger: From the beginning or on another occasion after an earlier attempt.

alfalfa.gentle: A plant grown for animal fodder.
alfalfa.stronger: A hay crop in the pea family with three-part leaves and clusters of small purple flowers.

alga.gentle: A simple organism often found in water.
alga.stronger: A photosynthetic organism such as a kelp or diatom, lacking true roots, stems and leaves.

algal.stronger: Describes growths such as the green blooms formed by microscopic organisms in water.

allay.stronger: Calm someone’s fears or ease their anxiety.

allow.stronger: Consent to someone doing something they would otherwise be prohibited from doing.

alloy.stronger: A material such as bronze or steel, made by combining a metal with other elements.

ally.stronger: A person who supports or helps you in a shared effort.

aloe.stronger: A plant of a group mostly found in Africa, with a rosette of fleshy leaves and showy flower spikes.

alto.gentle: Of a low female singing range.
alto.stronger: Describes the bottom female voice part in a typical four-part choir.

ambo.gentle: A raised platform for a speaker.
ambo.stronger: An elevated place that makes a speaker easier to see, such as a stand for readings in a church.

angina.gentle: Chest pain caused by poor blood supply to the heart.
angina.stronger: Episodes of chest discomfort when too little oxygen reaches the heart muscle.

anti.stronger: Describes someone or their position when they are against a particular action or policy.

area.stronger: A particular branch of knowledge or research within a broader subject.

aria.gentle: A piece for a solo singer.
aria.stronger: An elaborate solo song, such as one a character sings in an opera.

array.stronger: A set of items deliberately laid out in a pattern, such as rows and columns.

arty.stronger: Describes someone or something that imitates the manner of artists for effect.

ashy.stronger: A shade of grey like the powder left after something burns.

asphyxia.stronger: A condition that can occur when breathing is blocked and normal gas exchange stops.

assay.gentle: A report of a chemical analysis.
assay.stronger: A written account of what a test found in a sample, such as the proportion of gold in ore.

ataxia.stronger: Loss of control over voluntary muscle movements that may make walking unsteady.

awash.stronger: Describes a surface with water lying or sweeping across it, like a deck after a wave breaks.

awed.gentle: Filled with a sense of wonder.
awed.stronger: Showing reverence mixed with amazement and a little fear in the presence of something impressive.

awry.stronger: In a way that departs from what should have happened, as when a plan goes wrong.

axis.gentle: A reference line through a figure.
axis.stronger: An imaginary straight line that a body can rotate around or a shape can be symmetric about.

ayah.stronger: A historical term for a nursemaid employed to look after children in an Indian household.

baas.gentle: A term for someone in charge.
baas.stronger: A South African word meaning boss or master.

baba.stronger: An individual cake raised with yeast, sometimes soaked in syrup.

babe.stronger: A baby in its first year, before it can walk or talk.

back.gentle: A part of the body opposite the chest.
back.stronger: The area along the spine, below the neck.

ball.gentle: A round object used in play.
ball.stronger: A sphere that players kick, hit or throw in a sport or game.

barb.stronger: A pointed insult aimed at someone and meant to sting.

barber.gentle: Someone who cuts hair for a living.
barber.stronger: A tradesperson who gives haircuts and trims or shaves beards.

bare.stronger: Exposed because its usual outer layer has been removed or was never applied.

bask.gentle: Take pleasure in a good feeling.
bask.stronger: What you might do figuratively in the glow of praise.

bass.stronger: Describes the vocal or instrumental range at the bottom of a piece of music.

bast.gentle: A strong fibre from a plant stem.
bast.stronger: A woody fibre taken from tissue beneath the outer bark, as in flax or jute.

bear.stronger: A heavy, strong-clawed mammal of the family that includes the grizzly and giant panda.

bearer.stronger: One of the mourners who helps lift and carry the coffin during a funeral.

bedfellow.stronger: Someone you find yourself allied with for the moment, perhaps unexpectedly.

beef.stronger: The flesh of an adult cow or steer prepared as food, such as steak or a roast.

beer.stronger: A beverage made from grains and commonly flavoured with hops.

bell.stronger: A hollow metal device that gives a clear note when struck.

bier.gentle: A stand used at a funeral.
bier.stronger: A frame on which a coffin or body rests before burial.

blab.stronger: Reveal information someone trusted you to keep confidential.

blazing.stronger: Describes a sun so bright that it makes you squint.

blob.stronger: An indistinct lump or splash with an irregular outline.

bloc.stronger: Nations joined by a special political alliance or common interest.

blow.stronger: An event that frustrates plans or impedes progress.

blowback.stronger: False material planted abroad that circulates back to the country that planted it.

blowlamp.gentle: A tool that produces intense heat.
blowlamp.stronger: A handheld gas burner that mixes fuel and air to make a hot flame.

blue.stronger: Feeling downhearted and low in spirits.

bluebell.gentle: A plant with drooping blue flowers.
bluebell.stronger: A perennial whose slender stalks carry small blue, bell-shaped blooms.

bock.stronger: A traditionally German beer brewed in autumn and matured over winter for drinking in spring.

bola.gentle: A cord worn as a tie.
bola.stronger: A necktie made from a cord held together at the front by a decorative clasp.

boll.gentle: Part of a plant that holds seeds.
boll.stronger: The rounded seed capsule of a cotton or flax plant.

bomb.stronger: An event or production that flops so badly it has virtually no effect.

bong.stronger: A dull ringing sound like the deep note of a large bell.

boob.gentle: An insult for a foolish person.
boob.stronger: An informal term for someone who behaves ignorantly.

book.stronger: A set of bound pages that can sit on a shelf.

bookbinding.stronger: The work of assembling pages and attaching them to a cover.

boom.stronger: A time when business activity expands rapidly and sales, jobs or investment rise.

boor.stronger: Someone regarded as crude for behaving with little courtesy or social refinement.

bowl.stronger: An open-topped container you might fill with grain or soup.

brae.stronger: A Scots word for a sloping stretch of ground.

breeze.stronger: A gentle movement of air that can feel refreshing on a warm day.

bubble.stronger: A rounded globule of air or another gas surrounded by liquid, as in a fizzy drink.

bucksaw.gentle: A hand tool for cutting wood.
bucksaw.stronger: Its blade is held in an H-shaped frame for cutting logs.

bulb.gentle: An underground part that can grow into a plant.
bulb.stronger: A rounded storage structure that can send up new shoots, as in tulips and onions.

bull.stronger: An adult male of domestic cattle that has not been castrated.

bumble.stronger: Move on foot unsteadily, stumbling or tripping as you go.

bumblebee.stronger: A large, hairy bee of temperate regions that lives in a colony and often has yellow and black bands.

buss.stronger: An old-fashioned word for a press of the lips in affection or greeting.

bust.stronger: An informal noun for an effort or venture that flops and yields nothing worthwhile.

butt.stronger: The person at whose expense jokes are made or pranks are played.

cacao.gentle: A tropical tree grown for its seeds.
cacao.stronger: The American tree whose pods contain the beans from which chocolate is made.

call.stronger: A conversation or attempt to reach someone by telephone.

calla.gentle: A plant grown for its flowers.
calla.stronger: A South African ornamental with a white hood around a yellow central spike.

cark.stronger: An old-fashioned verb for troubling somebody's mind with worry.

casaba.stronger: A melon with a yellowish outer skin and pale, whitish flesh.

cask.stronger: A rounded container used for ageing wine or holding beer.

cassock.gentle: A formal garment worn in church.
cassock.stronger: An ankle-length robe often worn by clergy or choir members.

cede.stronger: Formally hand over territory or authority to someone else.

cheque.gentle: A written instruction to make a payment.
cheque.stronger: A signed order telling your bank to pay an amount from your account to the named recipient.

chequered.gentle: Covered with a regular geometric pattern.
chequered.stronger: Marked by alternating squares of contrasting colours, like a chessboard.

choc.gentle: A shortened name for a sweet treat.
choc.stronger: Informal British abbreviation for the cocoa-based confection.

chock.gentle: Something that keeps a heavy object from moving.
chock.stronger: A block wedged against a wheel to stop it rolling.

chockablock.stronger: Describes a place so full there is hardly room for anything else.

choking.stronger: This can occur when food blocks the airway.

clay.gentle: Fine earth that can be moulded.
clay.stronger: A fine-grained material that is pliable when damp and hardens when fired in a kiln.

cloaca.gentle: A shared bodily outlet in many animals.
cloaca.stronger: The chamber in birds and reptiles where the digestive, urinary and reproductive tracts meet.

clot.gentle: A lump formed in a liquid.
clot.stronger: A mass made from substances that have thickened or solidified out of a fluid, such as coagulated blood.

coach.stronger: A person who prepares an athlete or team for competition by teaching skills and directing practice.

coal.stronger: A combustible rock formed from ancient plant material.

coca.gentle: A shrub native to South America.
coca.stronger: An Andean shrub whose leaves have traditionally been chewed for their stimulant effect.

cock.gentle: A turning control for a flow of water.
cock.stronger: A tap that uses a rotating valve to regulate liquid.

coco.stronger: The tall palm that produces large, hard-shelled fruits with white flesh.

cocoa.stronger: A usually hot drink made by stirring powdered roasted beans and sugar into milk.

coho.stronger: A silvery species native to the north Pacific.

cola.stronger: A carbonated soft drink traditionally flavoured with kola nut extract.

colt.stronger: A male horse that has not yet reached four years of age.

cook.stronger: What you do at the stove to make dinner.

cookbook.stronger: A volume of recipes with instructions for preparing dishes.

cool.stronger: Describes air that feels pleasantly chilly on a hot day.

coot.gentle: A dark bird often seen on ponds.
coot.stronger: A slate-black waterbird that looks somewhat like a duck and has a slow flight.

cork.gentle: The outer bark of a particular oak.
cork.stronger: Light, springy bark used for things like bottle stoppers or pinboards.

cosh.stronger: A blunt striking weapon, traditionally a leather-covered piece of metal with a flexible handle.

cottonmouth.stronger: A semiaquatic species found around swamps in the southern United States.

crack.stronger: A slender gap through which you might see a sliver of light.

crazily.stronger: How someone behaves when acting as though reason has gone out the window.

cred.gentle: Informal standing or respect among peers.
cred.stronger: The respect someone earns in fashionable youth circles by being seen as authentic.

crow.gentle: A bird with a harsh call.
crow.stronger: A usually black bird known for its loud, rough caw.

cure.stronger: Prepare meat or fish so it keeps longer by removing moisture or treating it with salt.

cuss.stronger: A swear word said out of surprise or anger.

cyclical.stronger: Describes events that return to the same stages in sequence, such as seasonal changes.

dace.stronger: A slender bluish-green fish that lives in rivers and streams in Europe.

dead.stronger: Describes an organism whose vital functions have permanently ceased.

deck.stronger: The standard set of 52 cards divided among four suits.

deed.stronger: A signed instrument that can transfer ownership of a property.

deep.gentle: Extending a long way down or in.
deep.stronger: Describes a well with a distant bottom or a cut that penetrates far below the surface.

deer.stronger: In most species, the males grow solid antlers that are shed and regrown.

defy.stronger: Refuse to submit to an order or authority, even in the face of consequences.

dell.stronger: A small wooded hollow nestled between slopes.

delude.stronger: Deceive a person into accepting something false as true.

denude.stronger: Strip something until it is bare, as when land is cleared of vegetation.

denuded.stronger: Describes something left bare, such as a hillside after all its plant cover has been removed.

derv.stronger: A British term for diesel used by cars and lorries.

devilry.stronger: Cruel acts or conduct described as fiendish.

diddly.stronger: An informal word for a quantity so small that it scarcely counts.

dive.stronger: A headfirst entry into a pool or other body of water, often from above the surface.

dodo.gentle: An extinct bird that could not fly.
dodo.stronger: A heavy, flightless relative of pigeons that once lived on Mauritius.

doer.stronger: A person who gets things done by acting on plans and ideas.

door.gentle: A movable barrier at an entrance.
door.stronger: A hinged or sliding panel that opens and closes the way into a room, building or vehicle.

doorjamb.gentle: Part of a frame around an opening.
doorjamb.stronger: One of the upright sides of a frame, where the hinges or latch can sit.

dove.stronger: One of a group of pigeon species such as the turtle or mourning varieties.

drove.gentle: A group of animals on the move.
drove.stronger: A herd or flock travelling together, such as cattle being driven along a road.

drover.stronger: Someone whose work is driving a herd of cattle or sheep from place to place.

dryer.stronger: A machine that takes water out of something such as freshly washed clothes.

dude.gentle: An informal way to address someone.
dude.stronger: A casual term for a man, as when calling to a mate.

duel.gentle: A formal fight between two people.
duel.stronger: A prearranged single combat, historically fought with weapons to settle a matter of honour.

duff.stronger: A firm steamed or boiled pudding that can contain raisins, currants or candied peel.

dull.stronger: Describes something so flat or uneventful that it fails to hold one's interest.

dulled.stronger: Describes a blade whose edge has worn down so that it no longer cuts cleanly.

dumb.stronger: Temporarily lost for words through shock, astonishment or another strong feeling.

dumbbell.stronger: A handheld weight with two heavy ends joined by a short grip.

dune.stronger: A ridge or mound built by windblown sand, often on a coast or in a desert.

dupe.stronger: Fool a person into believing a hoax or acting on false information.

dyed.stronger: Describes fabric whose colour was added after it was made.

dyer.stronger: A textile worker who applies dyes to fabric as a trade.

echo.gentle: A sound heard again after a delay.
echo.stronger: The repetition you hear when sound waves bounce back from a surface such as a cliff.

ecru.stronger: A light beige shade resembling unbleached linen.

eddy.stronger: A little whirlpool where moving water curls back on itself.

edge.stronger: The outer boundary of a flat face, such as the line where a tabletop stops.

edged.gentle: Having a border of a given kind.
edged.stronger: Describes something finished around its margins, such as fabric trimmed with lace.

eerie.stronger: Describes an atmosphere so mysterious it seems to hint at something supernatural.

elude.stronger: Evade a pursuer or slip out of someone's grasp.

ended.stronger: Describes an activity or event that has reached its conclusion.

endue.gentle: Give someone a quality or ability.
endue.stronger: An old-fashioned verb for bestowing a capacity or trait on a person.

error.stronger: A wrong action caused by poor judgement, lack of knowledge or a moment's inattention.

ever.stronger: An adverb used in questions about whether something has happened before.

every.gentle: All members of a group, taken one at a time.
every.stronger: A word before a singular count noun that includes each instance with no exceptions.

ewer.stronger: A vessel with a handle and spout, often paired with a washbasin.

extroverted.stronger: Describes someone who finds it easy to strike up a conversation.

eyed.gentle: Having organs of sight of a stated kind.
eyed.stronger: Having optical features of a specified sort, as in a compound describing their number or colour.

fail.stronger: Try to achieve an objective and come up short.

fain.stronger: An archaic adverb for doing something with pleasure or ready consent.

fall.stronger: The time of year before winter when many deciduous trees shed their leaves.

familiarly.stronger: How someone speaks when they address another person as though they know them very well.

feed.stronger: Grain, pellets or other rations supplied to livestock.

feel.stronger: The texture or resistance noticed when you run your fingers across a material.

fell.stronger: An old term for a hide prepared for use, especially one from a large animal.

feud.stronger: A lasting dispute in which two people, families or other groups remain hostile to each other.

fief.gentle: Land held under a medieval system.
fief.stronger: An estate granted by a lord to a vassal in return for allegiance or service.

fife.stronger: A shrill instrument often played alongside drums in a marching band.

fill.gentle: Material used to occupy a space.
fill.stronger: Material such as loose soil placed in a hole or layered into a low area to raise its level.

fink.gentle: A person who informs on others.
fink.stronger: A disparaging term for someone who secretly passes information about others to the police.

fire.stronger: An instance of flames consuming something, such as a blaze that damages a building.

fitting.stronger: Describes a gesture or choice that suits the character or spirit of an event.

fixedly.stronger: How someone stares when they keep their gaze on one spot.

flak.stronger: A barrage of disapproval aimed at someone whose actions or decisions have drawn objections.

flay.stronger: Remove the skin from a body, as when taking the hide from an animal.

flee.stronger: Escape hurriedly from danger or pursuit.

flow.gentle: The movement of a liquid or gas.
flow.stronger: The motion of a fluid as it travels along a path.

flue.gentle: A passage for carrying smoke away.
flue.stronger: A duct that channels smoke or exhaust gases from a fireplace or furnace to the outside.

fluff.stronger: A loose mass of soft, fine fibres like the lint on a blanket.

follow.stronger: Travel in the same direction as a person or vehicle ahead of you.

fool.stronger: A jester paid to amuse a medieval ruler or noble with jokes and antics.

foul.stronger: Describes an odour so bad it makes you want to turn away.

fowl.gentle: A bird commonly raised on farms.
fowl.stronger: A domesticated chicken descended from jungle birds.

free.stronger: Describes something you can obtain or use without paying a fee.

frequent.stronger: Describes events that recur with little time between them.

fuel.gentle: A substance used to obtain energy.
fuel.stronger: Material such as coal, petrol or wood that releases energy when consumed.

full.stronger: Containing as much as the container can normally hold.

fuss.stronger: A commotion caused by people getting worked up or flustered about something.

gaga.stronger: So taken with a person or thing that it occupies much of one's attention.

gain.stronger: The difference by which a later total exceeds an earlier one.

gala.stronger: A festive occasion often marked by special entertainment and formal dress.

gall.gentle: An abnormal growth on a plant.
gall.stronger: A lump on a leaf, twig or stem that can form in response to an insect, infection or injury.

gamma.gentle: A letter of the Greek alphabet.
gamma.stronger: The Greek letter that comes after beta and before delta.

gang.stronger: A team assigned to labour together on a job, such as laying railway track.

gene.stronger: A segment of DNA containing instructions involved in making a particular protein.

gift.stronger: An ability that comes naturally, such as an exceptional ear for music.

gill.stronger: One of the thin structures under the cap where spores are produced.

glib.stronger: Describes a slick explanation that sounds convincing until you examine it more closely.

gong.stronger: A flat or rounded metal plate sounded with a padded mallet.

goon.stronger: An insulting term for someone regarded as clumsy or dim-witted.

graveyard.stronger: Ground set aside for graves, sometimes next to a church.

gull.stronger: A bird often seen along coasts, with long pointed wings and short legs.

gunfight.stronger: An armed confrontation in which shots are fired at others.

hack.gentle: A person who does tedious work.
hack.stronger: Someone who toils diligently at boring professional tasks.

hackwork.stronger: Commissioned prose turned out routinely with little originality.

hash.gentle: A cooked dish of chopped meat and potato.
hash.stronger: A mixture of diced meat and potatoes fried until browned, often made with leftovers.

hassock.gentle: A thick cushion with a specific use.
hassock.stronger: It supports your knees when kneeling to pray.

heed.stronger: Take notice of a warning and act on it.

heedfully.stronger: How you act when you consider each step deliberately.

held.stronger: Describes a place or position in someone's control, often with the controller named before it.

here.stronger: An adverb pointing to the current location of the person speaking or writing.

hexagram.stronger: A six-pointed shape that can be drawn with two overlapping triangles.

hock.gentle: A joint in a hoofed animal.
hock.stronger: The joint on a horse’s hind leg corresponding to the human ankle.

home.stronger: Describes a match played at the venue belonging to the team playing there.

hooch.stronger: Slang for spirits distilled illegally, often of poor quality.

hook.gentle: A tool for catching or holding something.
hook.stronger: A curved piece that can snag an object or hang it from a rack.

hookah.stronger: Smoke passes through water before reaching the mouthpiece through a long hose.

hooks.stronger: Informal name for the large, strong hands a boxer can make into fists.

hoot.stronger: A call like the hollow sound made by an owl.

hose.stronger: A bendable tube for conveying water or another fluid, such as the one used to water a garden.

howl.stronger: The drawn-out, plaintive call of a wolf or hound.

hush.stronger: A quiet stillness that settles over a place after sounds die away.

idly.stronger: In a way that fills time without any particular aim or productive effort.

idyll.gentle: A short poem about country life.
idyll.stronger: A brief pastoral verse portraying scenes or people of the countryside.

imam.stronger: A person who leads congregational prayers in a mosque.

inning.gentle: A division of play in a sport.
inning.stronger: In baseball, both teams get a turn at bat during each one.

inquest.stronger: An inquiry to establish the cause of an unexpected death.

jack.stronger: A relative of breadfruit with edible pulp and large seeds that can be roasted.

jawbreaker.gentle: A sweet that is hard to bite.
jawbreaker.stronger: A large, round, hard piece of confectionery that you usually suck.

jumbled.gentle: Mixed up and out of order.
jumbled.stronger: Describes a pile whose parts have lost any clear arrangement.

jumpsuit.gentle: An outfit with the top and trousers joined.
jumpsuit.stronger: A one-piece garment inspired by what parachutists wear.

just.stronger: Treating all parties as reason and conscience demand, with equal consideration for their claims.

jute.gentle: A plant fibre used for cordage.
jute.stronger: A coarse fibre spun into twine or woven into sturdy sacks and hessian.

kibitzer.gentle: A person who gives unwanted advice.
kibitzer.stronger: Someone who watches others at a game and insists on telling them what to do.

kill.gentle: The prey taken by a hunter.
kill.stronger: The body of an animal after a predator has brought it down.

kink.gentle: A sharp bend in a line.
kink.stronger: A tight bend in a cord that can form when a twist or loop is pulled taut.

kola.gentle: A tree grown for caffeinated nuts.
kola.stronger: A tropical tree whose reddish or brown seeds have been used to flavour soft drinks.

kook.gentle: An informal term for an unconventional person.
kook.stronger: Someone regarded as eccentric enough to stand apart from a group.

lack.stronger: Have none of a quality or resource, or have less of it than is required.

lacy.stronger: Having the fine, decorative openwork of a fabric made from interwoven threads.

lair.stronger: A den or secluded place where a wild animal lives or rests.

lamp.stronger: A device that gives off visible light, such as one powered by electricity or burning oil.

latrine.stronger: A basic public toilet in a military camp.

lazy.stronger: Describes someone who would rather avoid work or physical exertion when they could do it.

leer.stronger: A sideways glance or grin that conveys an unwelcome interest or a sneer.

liar.stronger: Someone who deliberately says things they know are untrue, especially as a habit.

lignin.stronger: A tough polymer reinforcing plant cell walls and giving wood its rigidity.

lily.stronger: A plant of the genus Lilium, known for large, showy blooms.

ling.stronger: A marine fish found in northern waters, sometimes preserved by salting and drying.

lining.stronger: Fabric sewn inside a coat to cover seams or improve comfort.

lira.stronger: The unit divided into 100 centesimi that Italy used before adopting the euro.

loam.stronger: Fertile soil made up of sand, clay and decaying organic matter.

local.gentle: Relating to government close to home.
local.stronger: Having to do with the administration of a city, town or district.

lock.gentle: A fastener that keeps something shut.
lock.stronger: A mechanism that secures a door or drawer, commonly operated with a key.

loco.stronger: An informal adjective for someone behaving in a wildly irrational way.

logo.stronger: A graphic mark designed to identify a business on signs, products or packaging.

loll.stronger: What an arm may do over the edge of a chair when left limp.

lollop.stronger: Move in a clumsy, springing gait with your body bobbing at each stride.

lolly.gentle: A frozen treat on a stick.
lolly.stronger: A chiefly British name for ice cream or flavoured ice held by a small wooden handle.

look.stronger: A visible sign of emotion on someone's face, such as surprise or disapproval.

loom.stronger: An apparatus that holds lengthwise threads taut while crosswise yarn is worked through them to make cloth.

loop.stronger: A round or oval shape whose line joins back to its starting point without crossing itself.

loot.stronger: Valuables acquired by theft or plunder, such as the proceeds of a robbery.

lore.stronger: Stories, customs and practical knowledge passed along informally, often by word of mouth.

loss.stronger: A reduction over time in the amount of something, such as a steady drop in the moisture a material holds.

loyal.stronger: Describes someone who remains faithful to a duty or a group even when tested.

loyally.stronger: In a way that shows continued devotion to a person, cause or duty even in difficult circumstances.

lube.stronger: A slippery substance such as oil or grease that helps moving surfaces slide past one another.

luff.gentle: The front edge of a sail.
luff.stronger: The leading edge of a fore-and-aft sail, usually beside the mast.

lull.stronger: A temporary letup in noise, work or excitement before it resumes.

lulu.stronger: An old slang term for a woman seen as especially beautiful or alluring.

lung.stronger: One of the paired chest organs that transfer oxygen to the blood and remove carbon dioxide.

magma.stronger: Hot liquid rock within Earth's crust that is called lava once it reaches the surface.

main.gentle: Able to stand alone as a clause.
main.stronger: Describes an independent clause that can form a complete sentence without a supporting clause.

mama.gentle: A familiar word for one's mother.
mama.stronger: An affectionate name a young child may use when calling their mother.

mamma.stronger: A gland in the breast or udder that secretes milk to nourish young.

manana.stronger: A borrowed Spanish word used to put something off until a vaguely defined future day.

mania.stronger: An overpowering urge or preoccupation that drives a belief or behaviour despite a lack of good reason.

manna.gentle: Food said to have come from heaven.
manna.stronger: In Exodus, the food God provides for the Israelites during their journey through the wilderness.

mare.gentle: A female member of the horse family.
mare.stronger: A female equine, such as an adult female horse.

mart.gentle: A place in town for trading goods.
mart.stronger: A public commercial site in a town set aside for buying and selling.

mask.stronger: Something worn over part or all of the face to conceal one's identity.

mass.gentle: The physical property that gives an object weight.
